snippet.title: FATAL FURY: CotW ｜ NIGHTMARE GEESE
snippet.description:
Nightmare Geese chills the playable roster in FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves from today! 
Don’t miss the ongoing 20% OFF sale! 🔥

■ NIGHTMARE GEESE (Voice Actors: Richard Epcar)
Former emperor of South Town. Revered by some, reviled by others, and targeted for revenge by a hungry few—a legend in his own right, even in the afterlife. Though no longer of this world, the horrors of Geese Howard remain a bane to all who knew him. His legacy is a testament to the power of one terrible truth: Legends never die. Their nightmare lives on...

----------------------------------------------------

Legends unleashed! Get 20% off the Legend Edition, which bundles the base game with Season Passes 1 and 2!

■ Title
FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves Legend Edition (Season Pass 1 + 2)
